A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the stat boxes and the game-text box) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 March 2017 (the PDF was made on 31 May 2017).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:DS2-L-firstofficerthaneespi-PC-Errata-2017-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[First Officer Thaneespi (PC Errata 2013 slip)]] (16 April 2013): Same words as the 2013 slip. The 2017 slip prints no title in the strip below the text box; only the “E” remains. The 2013 slip sets ''Home One'' upright; the 2017 slip, the E card and the D-E1 card set it in italics, as the printed card does. The words are the same.

The 2013 slip and the 2017 slip, each as cut from its sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
